_doc: Hex levels for every non-hub land hex. 0 Junk -> 1 Clean -> 2 Planted -> 3 Growing -> 4 Sustained -> 5 Thriving. Levels never drop. planted_min_frac = share of a hex's plant slots that must be planted for Planted. growing_life = garden hex_life for Growing. Sustained: while Growing, the planted slots must have water > 0 for sustain_ratio of the last sustain_window_s seconds (sampled every sample_s); watering robots (Drip, Multibot on water) keep this up. Thriving: Sustained, every planted slot in bloom, hex_life >= thriving_life, and still watered. reward = one-off currencies on reaching the level. bonus = small permanent bonus per hex at that level (grow_pct: faster plant growth, seed_pct: more seeds from blooms), summed over hexes and capped by bonus_caps; cubes_per_min = a garden stipend in cubes per minute (Sustained/Thriving hexes keep paying after the junk is gone); wildlife_cubes_per_min = [money] a small cube trickle from wildlife notes on Thriving hexes (was research Data; research costs cubes now), so research keeps moving in a finished district. [M3-19] A hex's stage pays no cubes and there is no garden stipend or wildlife trickle: cubes come only from Lumi's own loads and bales and from the CITY stage payout (districts.json stage_reward). A hex's stage still gives back seeds. [M3-06] tending (plants/tending.gd, plants/garden.gd; design spec section 5): wet_s = seconds of full growth one watering gives every plant on the hex (3 minutes); dry_rate = growth rate of a thirsty plant (a quarter); burst_stage = share of a stage every plant on a hex grows at once when Lumi waters it; rewater_s = seconds before the same hex can burst again; patch_size = plants one planting action sets; patch_radius_m = how far round the first slot a patch reaches; patch_seeds = seeds one patch costs. [B44] The crew tends the same slots: crew_patch_size = plants one planting robot sets per action (its action takes 3 s over its work_rate, robots.json), for crew_patch_seeds seeds from the shared store; crew_rewater_frac = share of wet_s a plant has left when a watering robot comes back to its hex (so a tended hex stays wet through the sustain window). A robot's watering gives no burst (that is Lumi's pour). With these a hex goes from clean to growing in about 2 minutes of tending (tests/test_tending.gd). fx (per level) = the level-up's own look and sound, larger at higher stages: sound and pitch (Audio ids), db, burst (Vfx burst id), scale (burst and float text size), ring (true: a ring round the hex). Every level from 2 also pays field data (the research table's data_rewards.hex_stage), shown in the float text.
